<issue>
Setting right_margin affects left_margin instead

#### Description

When setting the `right_margin` property on a section, it incorrectly modifies the left margin instead of the right margin.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
from docx import Document
from docx.shared import Inches

# Create a new document
doc = Document()
section = doc.sections[0]

# Set right margin to 0.5 inches
section.right_margin = Inches(0.5)

# Check the actual margins
print(f"Left margin: {section.left_margin}")
print(f"Right margin: {section.right_margin}")

# Expected: Left margin should be unchanged, right margin should be 0.5 inches
# Actual: Left margin gets set to 0.5 inches, right margin remains unchanged
```

The issue occurs when trying to set the right margin - instead of updating the right margin value, it updates the left margin value.
</issue>
